sources.origin: Structural Causal Simulation grounded in Razorpay Dispute Domain Ontology
sources.role: Core benchmark for learning curves, sample efficiency, compositional generalization, and formal SMT verification
sources.prohibited_inference: Must not be claimed as real merchant dispute records; Oracle labels originate strictly from underlying SCM state.

sources.source_name: Federal Reserve CardSim: A Bayesian Simulator for Payment Card Fraud Research
sources.origin: Public Federal Reserve Payment Card Behavioral Simulator
sources.role: Transaction-distribution priors, amount magnitudes, temporal behavior, and auxiliary tabular representation
sources.prohibited_inference: CardSim fraud labels must NOT be used as chargeback evidence consistency ground truth.

sources.source_name: Reproducible Machine Learning for Credit Card Fraud Detection Handbook
sources.citation: Le Borgne et al., Practical Handbook (2022)
sources.origin: Public synthetic temporal payment simulator with class imbalance and feature drift
sources.role: Temporal walk-forward verification, non-stationary feature drift stress, and rolling backtests
sources.prohibited_inference: Transaction fraud classification target is separate from chargeback evidence integrity.

sources.source_name: CORD: Consolidated Receipt Dataset for Post-OCR Parsing
sources.citation: Park et al., Document Intelligence Workshop, NeurIPS 2019
sources.origin: 1,000 real-world receipts with OCR and semantic key-information annotations
sources.role: Document evidence robustness: receipt line-item parsing, amount extraction, date extraction, OCR corruption stress
sources.prohibited_inference: Receipt parsing accuracy must not be merged with chargeback classification metrics.

sources.source_name: ICDAR 2019 Robust Reading Challenge on Scanned Receipts (SROIE)
sources.origin: 1,000 scanned Indonesian/English receipts for key information extraction
sources.role: Receipt key information extraction under physical optical scan degradation
sources.prohibited_inference: OCR token error rate is an auxiliary document stress metric, not end-to-end gate precision.

sources.source_name: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau (CFPB) Complaint Database Snapshot
sources.origin: Public consumer financial complaint narrative archive (retrieved pre-August 2026 policy change)
sources.role: Real-world financial language diversity, long-form dispute narrative stress, and open-set vocabulary OOD evaluation
sources.prohibited_inference: Consumer narratives are unverified consumer allegations; NEVER use as ground-truth chargeback fraud labels.

sources.role: Tests whether learned models memorize surface generator syntax or learn invariant financial state semantics
sources.prohibited_inference: Linguistic variety benchmark; distinct from external human-authored evaluation.
